# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** fourteen  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P3](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Charlotta dresses in a white garment so stiffly starched that it can stand on its own. She wears her hair in a rampant, crinkly style braided into two tails, which are tied with four bright blue ribbons after having previously been braided into innumerable plaits.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a brisk, energetic, and warm-hearted handmaiden. Deeply devoted to her mistress, she exhibits an intense obedience, likely willing to follow any instruction given to her.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011)_

## History

Charlotta served as the young maid and assistant to Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she helped host tea parties for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends. During a berry-picking trip, she confided her worries to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's sudden melancholy and changed behavior. Later, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helped facilitate a reunion between Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), Charlotta watched from a window alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and celebrated as the couple walked affectionately in the garden. She then joined in the discussions and preparations for Miss Lavendar's eventual wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), +18 more_

## Quotes

> "I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?"
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> "Yes, ma’am. Come in, ma’am. I’ll tell Miss Lavendar you’re here, ma’am. She’s upstairs, ma’am."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040)

> "and they’re married safe and sound, no matter what happens now. The bags of rice are in the pantry, ma’am, and the old shoes are behind the door, and the cream for whipping is on the sullar steps."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0032)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Charlotta and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) met when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovered [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and were invited inside for tea by Miss Lavendar. Charlotta considers [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) a friend, caring for her both on her own merits and out of devotion to her mistress. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later returns to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to assist Charlotta and Miss Lavendar with preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +10 more_

- Friend of — loving them for the sake of her adored mistress as well as for their own  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as a young maid, helper, and companion to the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Deeply devoted to her mistress, Charlotta worries when Miss Lavendar becomes melancholic and confides her concerns to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in hopes of cheering her up. Charlotta also helps prepare for Miss Lavendar's reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and celebrates when the two reconcile and eventually marry.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), +10 more_

- Serves under — help and companion  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
